verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms TOTP codes sync across 'Bitwarden apps' and vault access is available via browser extension and CLI on a computer, implying desktop-class access, but no citation explicitly documents a native desktop application (GUI) separate from the browser extension/CLI. Missing for 10: explicit desktop app documentation, screenshots/feature parity claims, and independent confirmation that a first-class desktop GUI (not just extension/CLI) exists and works well.
